question: In November 2024, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred the highest National Award 'Dominica Award of Honour'. This award recognises his contributions ________.

options.text: in the development of the IT sector of the country
in the development of the agriculture sector of the country

solution:
The Correct answer is __**during the COVID-19 pandemic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was conferred the highest National Award of Dominica, named the '**Dominica Award of Honour**'.
 
• This prestigious award recognized his **exceptional leadership** and global contributions during the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• Under his guidance, India supplied critical **medical assistance, vaccines, and pharmaceutical products** to several countries worldwide.
 
• India established itself as a major contributor to global healthcare by providing **COVID vaccines** through its **‘Vaccine Maitri’ initiative**, which extended support to over 100 countries.
 
• India also shared its expertise, resources, and infrastructure with countries in need, including **manufacturing and distributing essential medicines** like **hydroxychloroquine** and **paracetamol.**
 
• Prime Minister Modi emphasized the importance of **global solidarity** and collaboration in tackling the pandemic, showcasing India's commitment to humanitarian values and international cooperation.
 
• His leadership during the pandemic highlighted India's ability to act as a **responsible global player** and earned respect internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Development of the IT sector of the country**__

 __
 
• India's **IT sector** is one of the largest globally, contributing significantly to the economy and employment.
 
• The **Digital India initiative**, launched in 2015 by Prime Minister Modi, aimed to transform India into a digitally empowered society.
 
• Key achievements include **expansion of broadband connectivity**, development of **e-governance platforms**, and promotion of **startups** in the IT domain.
 
• However, this option is incorrect in the context of the **Dominica Award of Honour**, which specifically recognized contributions during the **COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
 
 
• **Development of the agriculture sector of the country**__
 __
 
• Prime Minister Modi has launched several initiatives to strengthen India's **agriculture sector**, such as the **PM-KISAN scheme** and the **National Agriculture Market (eNAM).**
 
• India has focused on increasing **farm productivity, irrigation facilities**, and promoting **organic farming.**
 
• Despite these efforts, this option is not related to the award, which recognized contributions during the **global pandemic.**
 
 
 
• **During his first term governance**__
 
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi's first term (2014-2019) included key reforms such as **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**, **Goods and Services Tax (GST)**, and **Make in India initiative.**
 
• While these accomplishments significantly impacted India, they are unrelated to the **Dominica Award of Honour**, which specifically recognized his contributions during the **COVID-19 pandemic.**
